Welcome to Hotel Shalini

A quiet, homely base for the ancient capital

A homely, quiet guesthouse in Anuradhapura — with an open-air first-floor restaurant, a rooftop beer garden, and a family who will take you to the stupas, the lakes and into Wilpattu.

Hosted by the owner, Mr. Harshanath Gunasekera, with manager Cyril and the kitchen team — guests write home about the safaris organised overnight, and the rice and curry.

Dining

An open-air restaurant on the first floor

Western, eastern and Chinese cooking — and the home-style rice and curry guests write home about. Evenings end at the rooftop beer garden.

“Extremely good and tasty food. The manager’s hospitality towards guests is excellent.”Lashan A · Tripadvisor
